decision: Pursue one narrowly defined mechanism hypothesis at the analytical/CPU level: transport only image-to-text rotary phases to a fixed native-reference coordinate system while preserving the deployed image attention probabilities and total text probability exactly. Do not promote it as a novel method yet. Do not run another all192-case CR19 analysis or new capture merely to demonstrate nonzero sensitivity.

CR20_boundary.reported_common_stage_result: Both independent common-scale reviewers agree on seven satisfied-to-satisfied primary pairs and a native-violated/4K-unjudgeable celestial-layout pair. There is no primary native-success/4K-failure witness. Kneeling improves at4K; only auxiliary Paradis lettering regresses.
CR20_boundary.consequence: Close the tested semantic-loss rationale on those eight draws. Do not reinterpret the lettering case as a general-resolution target or change the frozen rubric. This negative screen does not establish that all resolution failures are absent.
CR20_boundary.detail_status: Detail reviews were in progress when the task was assigned. This note uses the reported common-stage result and does not invent a completed detail-stage result.
CR20_boundary.new_premise: The proposed mechanism instead addresses a public-supported architectural question: whether high-resolution spatial phase policies alter cross-modal compatibility unnecessarily when their purpose is to retain image-image detail. This is an unvalidated hypothesis for FLUX/Krea, not an observed cause of the CR20 images.

candidate.working_description: Native-reference image-to-text phase transport with fixed modality mass
candidate.target: At each image-query row, retain every deployed image-key probability and the total probability assigned to all text keys. Change only the conditional distribution within the text block to that obtained from the same content vectors under one declared native-reference phase map. Thus the intervention cannot improve a sample by simply increasing text strength or globally replacing the image geometry.
candidate.hypothesis: A single rotary geometry serves two different purposes in joint attention: distinguish image locations, and route image queries to nonspatial text tokens. A resolution extrapolator can improve the first while changing the second. Separating those two roles may preserve fine spatial discrimination without imposing the same phase policy on cross-modal compatibility.
candidate.why_this_is_not_an_established_defect: A different conditional text distribution need not be better. Learned content may compensate for phases, and some native positional dependence may be useful. Grid64x64 is the project's nominal1024 reference, not a verified hard boundary of FLUX/Krea training coordinates. Positions above63 must not be described as necessarily unseen during training.
candidate.actuator: A text-block logit replacement or its equivalent output correction. It is not a shared gain-vector fit, covariance normalization, generic native-flow guidance, PISA moment correction or a prompt-binding loss.
candidate.scope: Image queries only, all text keys including padded sequence positions, all24heads in all57joint/single attention calls at every one of the28denoising steps. Text-query rows remain unchanged at that block. No relation-word selection, text-token filtering, head/layer selection, timestep gate, clipping, tunable alpha, fitted strength or extra scalar guidance is introduced in the first defined operator. Uniform application avoids result-selected localization.

exact_operator.notation: For one image query i, let a_ij be deployed text logits over T and b_ik deployed image logits over I, already scaled by1/sqrt(D). Let Z_T=sum_T exp(a_ij), Z_I=sum_I exp(b_ik), m=Z_T/(Z_T+Z_I). Values v_j are unchanged. Let a'_ij be the target phase logits.
exact_operator.logit_actuation: Set a_tilde_ij=a'_ij+LSE(a_i)-LSE(a'_i), and keep b_ik unchanged. Then sum_T exp(a_tilde_ij)=Z_T exactly in real arithmetic.
exact_operator.probabilities: Every image probability exp(b_ik)/(Z_I+Z_T) is unchanged. New text probabilities equal m*softmax(a'_i). Old text probabilities equal m*softmax(a_i).
exact_operator.output: Let u_T=softmax(a_i)V_T and u'_T=softmax(a'_i)V_T. Then y'_i=y_i+m*(u'_T-u_T). The image weighted-value contribution is unchanged, and the corrected output is still a convex combination of the unchanged values in exact arithmetic.
exact_operator.information_and_size: KL(p'_full||p_full)=m*KL(p'_text_conditional||p_text_conditional), and ||y'-y||<=m*diameter(V_T). Report the mass-weighted effect, not just a large conditional KL when m is tiny.
exact_operator.native_identity: When the deployed grid and RoPE are the native reference, the target and deployed phases coincide, so a'=a and the operator is exactly the baseline in real arithmetic. The floating-point implementation still requires a no-op check.
exact_operator.unnormalized_control: For rho=Z'_T/Z_T, the same phase change without mass preservation gives y_uncorrected=[y+m*(rho*u'_T-u_T)]/[1-m+rho*m]. It uses the same original full output/LSE and two text branches, with no second full attention. Evaluate using stable log partitions and explicitly test extreme partition ratios; direct exp(logrho) can overflow. This control changes image probabilities and text mass, unlike the main operator.
exact_operator.mathematics_status: These are elementary softmax block identities and normalization constraints, not new theorems. The research contribution would have to be the specific controlled intervention and its demonstrated resolution benefit.

fixed_coordinate_and_content_policy.map: For each spatial axis of target length L>1 and native length L0=64, phi_L(p)=p*(L0-1)/(L-1). At256 this maps endpoints0 and255 exactly to0 and63. At64 it is the identity. Axis0 is unchanged.
fixed_coordinate_and_content_policy.rationale_and_alternative: The map preserves normalized canvas location and the endpoints of the declared reference domain. It is an explicit modeling choice, not a unique physical law. p/4 and pixel-center maps have different boundary behavior; they are not silently substituted or tuned after observing outputs.
fixed_coordinate_and_content_policy.frequencies: Use the base native frequencies theta10000 with the existing(16,56,56) axis dimensions for the image-to-text target. Keep the deployed official-SEGA frequencies for image-image attention. This is cross-block positional interpolation plus a partition constraint, not a new positional primitive.
fixed_coordinate_and_content_policy.same_content: In a live implementation, start from the actual normalized pre-RoPE Q/K at the same block. Preserve the actual pair-equal amplitude gains and all V. Compute the image query with the target spatial phases only for the text branch. Do not replace it by a native-resolution activation or feature average.
fixed_coordinate_and_content_policy.consumed_tensor_surrogate: For a saved post-RoPE consumed image query q_hat, the mathematical surrogate is q_hat'=R_base(phi(p))*R_deployed(p)^T*q_hat. Pair-equal gains commute with these rotations in real arithmetic. Saved BF16 multiplication and rotation rounding cannot be undone, so this is not recovery of the original pre-RoPE query. No saved-tensor sweep is recommended in this unit.
fixed_coordinate_and_content_policy.text_coordinates_and_padding: Standard FLUX conditioning uses zero spatial text IDs; retain that policy and all512 text positions exactly as presented to attention, including padding embeddings. Do not add a new mask, remove padding, or infer semantics from literal token attention. If actual captured/runtime IDs differ, reject this operator specification instead of assuming zeros.
fixed_coordinate_and_content_policy.joint_and_single_blocks: Apply the same image-row/text-column rule to the concatenated sequence in both block types. Leave the text-output rows untouched at the current block. Their later activations can still change through preceding modified image states, so this is not an end-to-end invariant text stream.
fixed_coordinate_and_content_policy.fidelity_limit: Native coordinates do not recover native content, latent/noise marginals, token population, text embeddings at later layers or denoising dynamics. Lower disagreement with this chosen phase target is not proof of native-model fidelity or higher image quality.

non_equivalence_counterexample.status: Evaluated with Python float64 math only in this unit; no model, external tensors or image quality labels.
non_equivalence_counterexample.construction: One rotary pair, D=2, pre-rotation q=(sqrt(2),0). Old phase pi/2 and new phase0 give old q=(0,sqrt(2)) and new q=(sqrt(2),0). Three text keys are(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0), with scalar values1,0,-1. One fixed image logit0 has value0. All logits include1/sqrt(2).
non_equivalence_counterexample.distinction: The old first and third text logits are tied. Any common text bias or scalar temperature, even followed by exact text-mass restoration, preserves that tie. The phase intervention breaks it. Thus the operator is not generally reducible to TIDE-style common bias or TACA-style scalar text temperature.
non_equivalence_counterexample.limit: This proves an actuator distinction only. Neither text key is labeled correct, so the changed output establishes no semantic or generative benefit.

closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.known: Separates cross-modal positional geometry from intra-image geometry with annular coordinates and alternating geometry in trained VLMs.
closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.difference: The current proposal keeps the deployed image-key probabilities exactly fixed and edits only image-to-text conditional phases in a frozen diffusion model. Separation of modality geometry itself is already known.

closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.known: Uses query-key-specific native coordinate scales for mixed-resolution image/video attention.
closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.difference: Block-specific or pair-specific phase maps are already known. The proposed text-only native-reference target plus fixed text mass is a narrower composition, not an invention of native-scale phases.

closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.known: Selectively changes rotary-frequency amplitudes on reference-image keys for shared-attention style transfer, preserving other token groups.
closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.difference: This proposal changes image-to-text phase rather than reference-image amplitude and constrains the partition mass. Token-group-specific rotary intervention is already known.

closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.known: Modality-specific temperature changes image-to-text logits and their relative odds; timestep scheduling and LoRA mitigate resulting distribution changes.
closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.difference: Rotation can break text-logit ties that any scalar temperature preserves. Fixed modality mass additionally removes aggregate cross-modal strength as the explanation. Merely changing relative text odds is not new.

closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.known: Resolution-dependent text-logit bias and step/frequency temperature control address text/image imbalance.
closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.difference: A common text bias alone preserves within-text odds. The present intervention deliberately leaves total text mass fixed and cannot repair pure text-mass dilution.

closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.known: Native-like receptive fields, global context, local detail and positional correction are established resolution mechanisms.
closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.difference: The proposed operator does not change support or fuse global/local image outputs. Its benefit would have to survive direct comparisons with those existing end-to-end approaches.

closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.known: Inference-time entity-attribute and entity-relation binding losses.
closest_collisions_and_remaining_differe.difference: No parsed relation, role loss or semantic attention-map target is used here. This distinction does not establish that the proposed coordinate target is useful.

novelty_assessment.established: Positional interpolation, selective rotary edits, modality-specific attention, and softmax partition normalization are all established. The proposed design is a composition of these ingredients.
novelty_assessment.potential_contribution: Demonstrate that correcting a native-reference cross-modal phase mismatch, while exactly holding spatial attention and modality strength fixed, improves resolution extrapolation at competitive cost. The constraint supplies a mechanism-specific comparison and may prevent damage caused by globally changing RoPE or text strength.
novelty_assessment.what_would_not_suffice: A nonzero toy response, a large conditional text KL, improved agreement with the chosen native-coordinate logits, or merely combining named components. No current result shows the combination necessary or beneficial.
novelty_assessment.status: No identical complete operator was found in the bounded targeted review. That is not novelty certification. A useful and empirically distinct composition can still contribute, but it must be presented as such rather than as a new theorem or attention family.

smallest_falsifiable_CPU_unit.current_execution: Only the closed-form three-text-key counterexample above was evaluated by this agent. No new helper, pretrained model, GPU or all192-case reanalysis was run by this agent. The evidence agent owns the separate implementation unit crope/crossmodal_phase.py and its tests; no filename conflict exists.
proposed_tests: Native64x64 identity on exact FP64 pre-RoPE tensors, both axes and multiple heads; target and deployed phases must agree.

For fixed synthetic Q/K/V and the declared map, verify text partition equality, each image probability equality, unchanged text-query rows, output-correction identity and mass-weighted KL identity within numerical tolerance.
The three-key tie-breaking example must remain distinct from all scalar-temperature-plus-common-bias controls; a positive temperature cannot create a new ordering from an old tie.

Include zero/negligible text mass, zero within-text value variation, large common logits, non-square geometry and explicit padding tokens. A changed conditional distribution with identical text values must give zero output change.
Test installed rotary pair convention and pair-gain commutation. Report FP32/BF16 no-op reconstruction and cast error separately from the intervention.

Reject claims that a single common Q/K transform preserves the full image block while realizing the specified text-only correction; test the explicit split-block implementation against a materialized small attention oracle.
smallest_falsifiable_CPU_unit.cost: Tiny synthetic tensors only, CPU2threads, no model weights. The tests are correctness and non-equivalence checks, not another artifact-wide response study or an efficacy gate.
smallest_falsifiable_CPU_unit.stop: If the proposed implementation leaks into image probabilities, changes native behavior beyond its numerical no-op floor, depends on hidden text masking, or needs an impractical extra full attention pass, fix or reject that implementation before generation. Passing these checks establishes a defined actuator only.

deployment_cost_and_feasibility.required_quantities: Original full attention output and row LSE, plus old and new text-only outputs/LSE. m=exp(LSE_text_old-LSE_full_old). Normalized SDPA output alone is insufficient to recover m.
deployment_cost_and_feasibility.additional_work: Two text-only QK/AV branches plus target query rotations, O(N_image*T*D*H). For N_image65536,T512, their arithmetic ratio to full joint QK/AV is2*N_image*T/(N_image+T)^2, about1.538percent. Against image-image arithmetic alone the ratio is1.5625percent. Neither includes rotations, memory movement, kernel launches, log-partition combination or transfers; neither is a latency claim.
deployment_cost_and_feasibility.no_common_transform_shortcut: A query rotation applied to the ordinary shared attention call also changes image-image logits. The exact block-specific correction requires separate text computation or a specialized fused kernel. The normalization correction is query dependent and also cannot be implemented by a common RoPE rotation.
deployment_cost_and_feasibility.memory: Avoid materializing all heads' N_image-byT logits together. Process query/head chunks or use text-only fused attention. At this geometry a single FP32 text-logit tensor across24heads is about3GiB before a second branch or workspace.
deployment_cost_and_feasibility.kernel_feasibility: Evidence agent inspected local PyTorch2.11.0+cu128 schemas: public F.scaled_dot_product_attention returns output only; aten._scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention with compute_log_sumexp=True returns output and FP32 LSE; the internal Flash op also returns LSE. Replacing the single full call with an LSE-returning backend can therefore avoid a repeated full image pass. Public varlen_attn has AuxRequest(lse=True), but the inspected backend selector forces Flash rather than preserving the current cuDNN preference; Flex attention also changes the compilation/kernel path. This is source/schema feasibility, not executed CUDA parity or latency evidence.
deployment_cost_and_feasibility.kernel_risk: Private ATen interfaces need pinned version, geometry, scale, mask, dropout and backend checks. If the intended LSE path fails numerical or throughput checks, do not silently fall back to an extra dense image reduction and call the intervention cheap. Record the actual backend and separately compare it with the current public-SDPA baseline.
deployment_cost_and_feasibility.numerics: Adding m*(u'_T-u_T) to a BF16 full output creates cancellation/cast questions. Accumulate the correction in FP32, define the final cast once, and compare no-op bytes and small-oracle error. Real-arithmetic preservation is not automatic BF16 bitwise preservation. No untested GPU-speed or exact-replay claim.
deployment_cost_and_feasibility.unnormalized_conditioning_risk: The unnormalized control multiplies the saved full output by c_y=1/(1-m+rho*m). If m is near1 and rho is small, this can amplify the BF16 output's rounding error even when every coefficient is finite. When the original image contribution is numerically lost in y-m*u_T, algebraic subtraction cannot recover it. Record coefficient amplification and compare extreme representable cases with a direct FP64 oracle. Reject irrecoverable/ill-conditioned controls rather than silently clip. A separate image-attention fallback would add cost and change the declared implementation; do not add it implicitly.
deployment_cost_and_feasibility.prospective_backend_tolerance: Parent proposes relativeL2<=1e-3 and cosine>=0.99999 for old public-SDPA versus LSE-returning-backend comparison, frozen before GPU execution. BF16 unit roundoff is2^-8, about0.003906, so1e-3 is a conservative engineering parity threshold, not a rigorous bound implied by dtype. Softmax/reduction errors and transformer/sampler propagation are additional. The cosine threshold is largely redundant at such small relative error for a nonzero reference; zero-norm cases need explicit absolute/exact handling. If the threshold fails, diagnose the backend instead of relaxing it after results. Same-backend native identity arms should be byte-equal to baseline, with formula correctness checked separately from the identity fast path.

public_resolution_observable_and_later_d.observable: Caption-grounded composition/attribute fidelity across the canvas at high resolution, together with preservation of local detail. AReA's public HRGen-1K qualitative composition/count comparisons and the cross-modal bias studies motivate this as a testable public task; they do not prove that the proposed phase policy causes or fixes those failures in Krea.
public_resolution_observable_and_later_d.distinguish_from_CR20: Do not select the Paradis example, reinterpret successful CR20 primaries, or demand a new native failure from the consumed eight captions. Existing development rows0and1 remain satisfied controls. A new pilot on them would test quality/detail/regression/cost under a provisional architectural hypothesis, not repair of a demonstrated semantic loss.
public_resolution_observable_and_later_d.bounded_generation_condition: After the tiny CPU tests and GPU numerical/backend smokes, the proposed next end-to-end screen is exactly existing development rows0and1, seed0,28steps,guidance4.5,4096x4096, three arms: matched LSE-backend baseline; native-phase with fixed text mass; identical native-phase without mass preservation. This is six trajectories, no extra prompt/seed search and no fresh64. Freeze source/model/sigma/backend/coordinate/rubric settings before execution; parent owns launch and cost planning. No job is launched by this design note.
public_resolution_observable_and_later_d.smokes_and_controls: First test native1024 identity and GPU kernel numerical behavior, including a same-phase no-op at the target geometry and the baseline public-SDPA versus LSE-returning-backend discrepancy. Preserve separate numeric receipts. An explicit native-identity fast path may return the original result, but also test the actual rotation/partition formulas on tiny tensors so bypassing does not hide a faulty implementation. The six generation arms must use the same validated LSE backend; archived CR14 is context rather than the sole numerical control.
public_resolution_observable_and_later_d.pilot_readout: Score and visually inspect all six outputs with the existing fixed development metrics and complete runtime/memory records. Preserve successful primary predicates and inspect detail/geometry regressions. With two already-satisfied prompts there is little primary-semantic headroom and no basis for significance or generality claims. The unnormalized arm tests whether the mass constraint matters. It does not rule out a useful mass-preserving temperature-only control; that remains the closest added control if a real signal warrants further work, rather than expanding this first pilot.
public_resolution_observable_and_later_d.what_positive_means: A consistent task improvement while image detail and runtime remain competitive would justify investigating this particular constrained composition and comparing stronger contemporary methods. It would not establish near-SOTA from four prompts or solve novelty by itself.
public_resolution_observable_and_later_d.what_negative_means: If the result matches a scalar temperature, damages detail, fails to improve the declared observable, or carries unacceptable LSE/kernel overhead, stop this mechanism without extending the same-state capture campaign. Fresh64 and prior held-out samples remain untouched.

rejected_second_candidate.name: Expected normalized native-cardinality random subsets
rejected_second_candidate.reason: Renormalized random key masks and their ensembles are close to DropKey. E[N/Z] differing from E[N]/E[Z] identifies a different operator but supplies neither a new mechanism nor a justified native target. At singleton uniform sampling it ignores affinity and becomes the mean value. Do not develop this as a second research branch now.
